article: Women’s Rights, Gender Equality, and International Legal Protection

primary_authorities.source_title: Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women
primary_authorities.notes: Core global treaty on discrimination against women.

primary_authorities.source_title: CEDAW General Recommendation No. 35 on gender-based violence against women
primary_authorities.notes: Updates General Recommendation No. 19 and frames gender-based violence as discrimination.

primary_authorities.source_title: Declaration on the Elimination of Violence against Women
primary_authorities.notes: Major UN declaration on violence against women.

primary_authorities.source_title: Security Council Resolution 1325 on Women, Peace and Security
primary_authorities.notes: Foundational Women, Peace and Security resolution.

primary_authorities.source_title: ILO Convention No. 190 on Violence and Harassment
primary_authorities.notes: International labor standard on violence and harassment in the world of work.

primary_authorities.source_title: Council of Europe Convention on preventing and combating violence against women and domestic violence
primary_authorities.notes: Regional treaty addressing violence against women and domestic violence.

further_reading.title: Human Rights of Women: National and International Perspectives
further_reading.notes: Foundational edited collection on women’s human rights.

further_reading.author: Charlesworth, H., Chinkin, C. and Wright, S.
further_reading.title: Feminist Approaches to International Law
further_reading.notes: Classic article in feminist international legal theory.

further_reading.title: Women, Peace and Security and International Law
further_reading.notes: Comprehensive treatment of WPS and international law.

further_reading.title: Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women

gender_equality_framework.practice_question: Does the law or policy distinguish on sex, gender, pregnancy, marital status, or related grounds?

gender_equality_framework.legal_function: Addresses unequal effects and structural barriers.
gender_equality_framework.practice_question: Does neutral language reproduce disadvantage in practice?

gender_equality_framework.legal_function: Targets institutional and social structures that produce subordination.
gender_equality_framework.practice_question: Does the measure change the conditions that make inequality durable?

gender_equality_framework.legal_function: Permits targeted measures to accelerate de facto equality.
gender_equality_framework.practice_question: Is the measure aimed at correcting persistent underrepresentation or disadvantage?

gender_equality_framework.legal_function: Requires prevention, investigation, punishment, and remedies for gender-based violence.
gender_equality_framework.practice_question: Did the state act reasonably before, during, and after the harm?

protection_mechanisms.legal_role: Monitors CEDAW implementation and issues concluding observations/general recommendations.
protection_mechanisms.use_case: Treaty reporting, shadow reports, individual communications where accepted.
Individual or group petitions and grave/systematic violation inquiries.

protection_mechanisms.mechanism: UN Women Peace and Security framework
protection_mechanisms.legal_role: Connects gender equality to conflict prevention, participation, protection, relief, and recovery.
protection_mechanisms.use_case: Conflict, peace processes, sanctions, peacekeeping, post-conflict governance.

protection_mechanisms.legal_role: Addresses violence and harassment in the world of work.
protection_mechanisms.use_case: Labor law reform, workplace protections, harassment prevention, remedies.

protection_mechanisms.legal_role: Interpret equality and violence standards through regional courts and commissions.
protection_mechanisms.use_case: Domestic violence, reproductive rights, political participation, trafficking, and state responsibility claims.
